subject: Recoverable daemon restarts: client retry + claim survival + idempotent writes + /version
description:
Make daemon restarts fully recoverable so in-flight work rides through them (see note-mq88939kmsi for the 4 verified failure mechanisms). State is already durable (atomic overlay writes, loops.json restore, persisted agent registry; workers are independent OS processes) — the fixes are POLICY:

1. CLIENT RETRY (lib/mcp-core.js makeCall, ~line 35-58): on connection-level errors ONLY (ECONNREFUSED/ECONNRESET/socket hang up before response), retry bounded (~3 attempts, 500ms backoff). ECONNREFUSED = request never arrived = always retry-safe. Keep the final-failure error message unchanged.
2. CLAIM SURVIVAL (daemon.js ~line 110-112): stop blind-demoting running→unknown on boot. Keep the persisted registry as-is; let the EXISTING staleness sweep (real liveness windows, config stale_minutes) release truly-dead agents. Verify the sweep actually covers the cases the demotion was for (kill/crash during downtime) — if a gap exists, tighten the sweep, don't restore blind demotion.
3. IDEMPOTENT WRITES for the non-idempotent routes (at minimum /overlay/note = record_decision, which mints a new id per call; audit /overlay/knowledge append and /dependency for retry-duplication): client (mcp-core makeCall) attaches a per-request op_id; daemon keeps a small persisted LRU (e.g. last 200 op_ids → response) and returns the cached response on duplicate. Only needed on mutating POSTs.
4. /version ENDPOINT: returns git HEAD of the daemon source, boot time, and key feature flags (e.g. gated-search present, targetOverlay reads/writes) so post-restart activation is verifiable in one call. Optionally a hooks/restart-daemon.sh that restarts then asserts /version HEAD == disk HEAD.

TESTS: extend the spawned-daemon test pattern (test/workspace-write-target.test.js style): (a) kill+restart the sandbox daemon mid-sequence and assert a retrying client completes its calls; (b) running agent claim survives a restart and is NOT re-claimable until the sweep window passes; (c) duplicate op_id returns the original response (no double note). All existing suites green (36 files).

HAZARDS: daemon.js is hot (heartbeat workers) — git status first, rebase, verify targetOverlay count (31) and gated-search intact after edits. Do NOT restart the live daemon; state restart-required. NOTE THE IRONY: this fix itself activates on the next restart — recommend doing that restart drained (check list_agents) one last time.
